title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Mark 15: Jesus before Pilate, Barabbas released, the mocking by the soldiers, Golgotha and the burial.

questions.text: To whom did the chief priests, elders and scribes deliver Jesus up in the morning?
questions.explanation: Immediately in the morning they held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

questions.text: What did Jesus answer when Pilate asked whether he was the King of the Jews?
questions.explanation: Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" and he answered, "So you say."

questions.text: Who was Barabbas, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

answers.text: A prisoner bound with insurgents who had committed murder
A servant of the high priest who had accused him
A robber who was crucified at his right hand
A soldier of the cohort in the Praetorium

questions.text: What did Pilate do because he wished to please the multitude?
questions.explanation: Wishing to please the multitude, Pilate released Barabbas to them, and handed Jesus over to be crucified after he had flogged him.

answers.text: He washed his hands of the whole matter
He sent Jesus back to the council to be judged
He released Barabbas and handed Jesus over to be crucified
He set both of the prisoners free at the feast

questions.text: What did the soldiers put on Jesus inside the Praetorium?
questions.explanation: They clothed him with purple, and wove a crown of thorns and put it on him.

answers.text: A white robe and a reed
Purple clothing and a crown of thorns
His own garments and a cloak
A linen cloth and a girdle

questions.text: Who was compelled to bear the cross of Jesus?
questions.explanation: They compelled Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was passing by and coming from the country, to bear his cross.

answers.text: One of the women who followed him from Galilee
One of the two robbers crucified with him
A soldier of the cohort in the Praetorium
Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus

questions.text: What does the name Golgotha mean, as this chapter explains it?
questions.explanation: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, "The place of a skull".

questions.text: What was written in the superscription of his accusation above him?
questions.explanation: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, "THE KING OF THE JEWS".

questions.text: What did Jesus cry out with a loud voice at the ninth hour?
questions.explanation: At the ninth hour he cried, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" which is interpreted, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

questions.text: Who went in boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who was himself looking for God's Kingdom, boldly went in to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

answers.text: The centurion who stood by opposite him
Simon of Cyrene, who bore his cross
Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member
